about_the_game:
Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors is a top-down auto-shooter roguelike inspired by Vampire Survivors.

Play as Pinocchio, a puppet trapped in a twisted fairy tale nightmare.Devour forbidden Dream Eggs, unleash powerful synergies through weapon sequencing and talent unlocking, and forge countless unique builds.

Conquer 22 Tarot Dream Challenges to unlock new characters and exclusive abilities.

Survive fast-paced bullet-heaven combat, make strategic choices, and fight your way out of the dream in this dark fairy tale adventure.

Core Gameplay

· Dream Eggs

In this nightmare realm, collect various Dream Eggs by slaying monsters, opening treasure chests, or purchasing from NPCs. These eggs are your core resource for enhancement - either equip them in your limited inventory for special effects, or...devour them! Consuming eggs grants unlimited attribute boosts, but at an increasing cost - the more you eat, the greater the consequences...

· Weapon Synergy

Wield three distinct weapon types that dynamically combine based on their arrangement order. Paired with Dream Eggs, innate talents, and Tarot abilities, creates countless combat variations and mutation forms. 

· Tarot Trials

The dreamscape holds 22 Tarot cards, each representing a unique challenge realm. Only by mastering special strategies can players conquer these trials to unlock new characters and powerful Tarot abilities!

· Endless Nightmare

Weaklings retreat after 25 dream layers - true warriors slaughter their way through infinite nightmares! Will you accept the challenge of these twisted fairy tale horrors?

Features

· Tower Climb & Endless Mode

Clear 25 timed floors (60 seconds each) in the Shallows - gather EXP and resources to prepare for the infinite Nightmare Realm!

· Keep or Devour?

Your inventory system offers strategic choices: Equip Dream Eggs for special effects or devour them for permanent boosts - each decision drastically alters your run!

· Limitless Builds

6 attack forms from 3 weapon types × 3 talents each × 22 Tarot powers × 100+ Dream Egg effects = Infinite combat possibilities!

· Skill Challenge

No mindless grinding! Our 22 Tarot Trials demand strategy (Currently, 11 Tarot Dream stages are available), reflexes, and sharp observation - but reward you with epic loot and satisfaction!

· 12 Playable Characters (Plan Expanding to 23)

Unlock new heroes with powerful exclusive skills by conquering Tarot Trials. More challenges cleared = more wild playstyles!

short_description: This is a top-down, auto-shooting roguelike that can be played entirely one-handed. Players take on the role of Pinocchio, fallen into a nightmare, collecting forbidden Dream Eggs that grant ever-changing offensive and survival abilities. Slay twisted fairy tale creatures in endless nightmares!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
